metrics.name: jul_acme_renewals_total
metrics.help: ACME certificate renewals observed (expiry advanced for a domain).

metrics.name: jul_auth_decisions_total
metrics.help: Access-control decisions, labeled by method (cidr/basic/jwt/forward) and result (allow/deny).

metrics.name: jul_cache_events_total
metrics.help: Response cache outcomes, labeled by state (HIT/MISS/STALE/BYPASS).

metrics.name: jul_discovery_errors_total
metrics.help: Failed or empty service-discovery resolves, labeled by pool (last-good backends are kept).

metrics.name: jul_grpc_proxy_streams_total
metrics.help: Native gRPC calls forwarded by the HTTP/2 passthrough proxy (one per call, including each streaming call).

metrics.name: jul_grpc_transcode_requests_total
metrics.help: gRPC-JSON transcoding requests, labeled by gRPC method full name and HTTP status code.

metrics.name: jul_grpc_transcode_stream_msgs_total
metrics.help: gRPC-JSON transcoding streamed messages, labeled by gRPC method full name and direction (sent to backend / received from backend).

metrics.name: jul_http3_connections
metrics.help: Current open HTTP/3 (QUIC) connections across all listeners.

metrics.name: jul_http_ratelimited_total
metrics.help: Requests rejected by rate limiting, labeled by key kind (ip/header/jwt).

metrics.name: jul_http_request_duration_seconds
metrics.help: HTTP request latency in seconds.

metrics.name: jul_http_requests_in_flight
metrics.help: Number of HTTP requests currently being served.

metrics.name: jul_http_requests_total
metrics.help: Total HTTP requests handled, labeled by method, host, and status code.

metrics.name: jul_http_response_compressed_total
metrics.help: Responses compressed by the edge, labeled by content coding.

metrics.name: jul_listener_conns
metrics.help: Current concurrent connections across all listeners.

metrics.name: jul_mtls_handshakes_total
metrics.help: Mutual-TLS handshakes presenting a CA-verified client certificate, labeled by result (verified/rejected). Certificates failing CA-chain verification are rejected by the TLS stack before this counter; a missing certificate denied per location is counted as a 403 in jul_http_requests_total.

metrics.name: jul_plugin_duration_seconds
metrics.help: WASM plugin invocation latency in seconds, labeled by plugin name.

metrics.name: jul_plugin_invocations_total
metrics.help: WASM plugin invocations, labeled by plugin name and result (continue/stop/error).

metrics.name: jul_plugin_panics_total
metrics.help: WASM plugin traps/panics contained by the host, labeled by plugin name.

metrics.name: jul_stream_active_conns
metrics.help: Current active L4 stream connections/sessions, labeled by protocol (tcp/udp).

metrics.name: jul_stream_bytes_total
metrics.help: Bytes relayed by the L4 stream proxy, labeled by protocol (tcp/udp) and direction (up to backend / down to client).

metrics.name: jul_stream_udp_sessions_evicted_total
metrics.help: UDP sessions removed by the L4 stream proxy to enforce limits, labeled by reason: 'idle' (reaped after idle_timeout) or 'lru' (reclaimed to admit a new client at the session cap).

metrics.name: jul_stream_udp_sessions_rejected_total
metrics.help: New UDP clients dropped because a listener's max_udp_sessions cap was reached and no session was reclaimable.

metrics.name: jul_tls_cert_expiry_seconds
metrics.help: Leaf certificate expiry as a Unix timestamp, labeled by domain.

metrics.name: jul_upstream_backends
metrics.help: Current number of backends in a pool, labeled by pool (tracks dynamic service discovery).

metrics.name: jul_upstream_healthy
metrics.help: Active health-check verdict per backend (1 healthy, 0 unhealthy), labeled by pool and backend.

metrics.name: jul_upstream_probe_duration_seconds
metrics.help: Active health-check probe latency in seconds, labeled by pool.

metrics.name: jul_upstream_probes_total
metrics.help: Active health-check probes, labeled by pool and result (success/failure).

metrics.name: jul_waf_events_total
metrics.help: Web-application-firewall rule matches, labeled by action (block/detect) and matched rule ID.
